fact: Ministerial Instructions 001/2012 (Ministry in the Office of the President in charge of ICT) recite that the national fibre optic backbone has been completed, and provide for government bandwidth to be distributed to institutions across the country over the National Backbone Optic Fiber; no regions or km are given. The document gives no date for completion, so as_of is the instruction's date.

TechTrends KE reports Liquid's East African footprint, including Rwanda, is connected through the company's own metro and national long-distance fibre networks; no Rwandan places or km are given. The article gives no date for the Rwandan network, so as_of is its publication date.
btw.media says KT Rwanda Networks, a government-Korea Telecom partnership, runs a fibre backbone of over 4,000 km connecting all districts and border areas.
btw.media says KT Rwanda Networks provides wholesale connectivity on its network to other mobile and internet service providers.
